thread:
Lina: Heads-up: after the noon rollout we're seeing a host-side P95 jump for streaming endpoints. Latency graphs show tokenization + parse spikes. Ticket: https://issues.redwood/INF-9123
Omar: Which ingest change landed? Any framer/coalesce or SETTINGS tweaks?
Lina: We flipped the new 'slimmerge' framer and tightened small-write coalesce to favor low-latency. That seems to increase micro-fragmentation for HTTP/gRPC streaming. KV prefix reuse down ~10% on impacted hosts.
Priya: Can you paste a short pprof/top from a hot box?
Lina: pprof cpu (20s):
```
pprof top
9.8% tokenize::stream_tokenize
7.4% parse::partial_unmarshal
6.2% http2::hpack_decode
5.5% grpc::writev_small
4.3% kvcache::lookup_miss_path
```
Lina: We're repeatedly tokenizing the same prefix because partial chunk boundaries are delivered early.
Raj: That matches sim perf runs I did: slimmerge reduces copies for big frames but increases number of partial-frame callbacks. Net effect: host CPU + KV misses. Also saw kernel-selection shift: more single-sample kernels chosen.
TelemetryBot: kernel-histogram (canary window): [single_sample: 42%, small_batch: 38%, large_batch: 20%] ; kv_prefix_reuse: 0.72 -> 0.63 (baseline -> canary)
Priya: Fast mitigations: bump ingress coalesce ceiling (1K->4K), relax slimmerge small-write threshold, or add a tokenizer micro-accumulator that holds partial prefix until delimiter or up to 512B. Which is lowest-risk?
Lina: I spun a quick canary: ingress_coalesce_max=4096 on 2 hosts + slimmerge small-write threshold back to old value. T+10m: P95 down ~9%, kv_reuse back to 0.71, CPU down ~7%.
Omar: Good. Follow-ups: (1) Raj to add kernel-selection telemetry per request and a breakdown by sequence-length bucket; (2) Priya to prototype prefix-accumulator (hold up to 256B) so tokenizer avoids re-tokenizing prefixes; (3) Lina to run 2h A/B and collect flamegraphs + full pprof.
Raj: Also recommend adding a CI microbench simulating 10k concurrent 1-6 token streaming sessions to prevent future regressions.
Priya: I'll try micro-accumulator in tokenizer; should be small and optional behind a flag.
Lina: Rolling A/B now. I'll attach artifacts here when A/B completes.
Omar: If A/B is stable we can roll the coalesce bump and tune slimmerge thresholds, then iterate on tokenizer flag. Add perf guardrails in nightly runs.
Lina: Update T+25m: A/B trending stable, canary P95 back to baseline. Leaving A/B for the hour then planning regional roll. End thread.
